mainEntity.name: How do you ensure a new home addition seamlessly matches the existing house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional builder ensures the expansion matches your home by carefully aligning roof pitches, matching exterior cladding, and maintaining consistent interior ceiling heights and trim. To blend the exterior, Bay City Remodeling coordinates roof tie-ins, window profiles, and full-house stuccoing or siding so the addition does not look tacked on. Inside, transitions between old and new areas require careful floor leveling, consistent drywall textures, and continuous flooring. Matching architectural elements preserves your home's curb appeal and protects its overall resale value.
acceptedAnswer.description: We tie into existing rooflines, match exterior stucco or siding, align interior floor levels, and use consistent drywall finishes, trim, and paint throughout the transition.
